title: Amazon Leo launches 36 satellites but struggles to close gap with Starlink
html:
Amazon's satellite internet initiative, Amazon Leo, has successfully launched another 36 low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites aboard Europe's Ariane 6 rocket, advancing its long-delayed commercial service rollout.

Credit: AFP
